metadata.name: 超级快速捐款 / Super Fast Donation
metadata.description:
接触普通或贪婪捐款机时，每秒完成约 100 次真实投币。所有金币会立即退还，0 金币也能捐款，并自动恢复卡币的机器。
While touching a normal or Greed Donation Machine, performs about 100 real donations per second. Every coin is refunded immediately, donating works at zero coins, and jammed machines are automatically restored.
